tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate an image via a logged-in web provider (ChatGPT web or Gemini web) and save it locally. Waits inline up to wait_seconds; if generation is still running, returns a job_id to poll with get_generation_status. The MCP does NOT judge quality — after completion, you (the caller) should view the saved file and decide whether to keep it or regenerate with a better prompt.

prompt.description: The image description to send to the provider

output_path.description: Target file (e.g. ./assets/hero.png) or directory. Directories are created automatically; existing files are never overwritten unless overwrite=true — a -1/-2 suffix is added instead.

aspect_ratio.description: Desired aspect ratio like "16:9", "1:1", "9:16". Folded into the prompt (web UIs have no direct control), so verify the result visually.

filename.description: Filename to use when output_path is a directory

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file (default false)

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait inline before returning a job id for polling (default 150)

tools.name: edit_image
tools.description: Edit an existing local image via a logged-in web provider: uploads the image, sends the edit instructions, and saves the edited result locally. Same job semantics as generate_image.

input_image_path.description: Path to the local image to edit

instructions.description: What to change in the image

output_path.description: Target file or directory for the edited image

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait inline before returning a job id for polling (default 150)

tools.name: generate_with_both
tools.description: Generate the same concept with BOTH providers (ChatGPT web + Gemini web) in parallel and save both images locally, so you can visually compare them and pick the winner. Each provider can succeed or fail independently.

output_path.description: Directory (recommended) or file-path stem where both images are saved

aspect_ratio.description: Desired aspect ratio like "16:9", "1:1", "9:16". Folded into the prompt (web UIs have no direct control), so verify the result visually.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait inline before returning a job id for polling (default 150)

tools.name: get_generation_status
tools.description: Check a generation/edit job started by generate_image, edit_image or generate_with_both. Returns status, saved file paths when finished, error details on failure, and recent job logs.

job_id.description: The job_id returned by a generation tool

wait_seconds.description: Optionally block up to this many seconds for the job to finish (default 0 = return current state)

tools.name: download_generated_image
tools.description: Copy a completed job's image(s) to an additional location. Note: jobs already save their output to the originally requested path automatically — use this only to place an extra copy somewhere else.

output_path.description: File or directory for the copy

tools.name: check_provider_session
tools.description: Check whether the persistent browser session for a provider is authenticated and usable. Never enters credentials — if not authenticated, it tells you to run provider_login so the user can log in manually.

tools.name: provider_login
tools.description: Open the provider's website in the (headed) persistent browser and WAIT for the user to log in manually — including any CAPTCHA or MFA, which are never automated. Ask the user to complete the login in the opened window; returns once login is detected or the wait times out. Requires the server to run with PIXEL_BRIDGE_HEADLESS unset/false.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for manual login (default 300)
